Question-level figures are split into readable domain panels. Complete multipage PDFs: [eFigure 2](output/manuscript/eFigure2.pdf), [eFigure 5](output/manuscript/eFigure5.pdf).

```{r}
invisible(Sys.setlocale('LC_CTYPE','English_United States.utf8'))
body_path <- 'output/manuscript/qa/supplement-body.html'
stopifnot(system2('quarto',c('pandoc','output/manuscript/Supplement.docx','--to=html',
  '--extract-media=output/supplement-media',paste0('--output=',body_path)))==0L)
stopifnot(system2('C:/Users/Ali-Salman/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/python/python.exe','../docs/manuscript/native-table-html.py')==0L)
raw <- paste(readLines('output/manuscript/qa/supplement-native.html',encoding='UTF-8'),collapse='\n')
knitr::asis_output(paste0('\n```{=html}\n',raw,'\n```\n'))
```
